decisions.reason: As a close extension of the home and interior accessories range in a growing furniture market, this decorative carpet fits the firm's broad design-led portfolio and there is no sign yet that it is underperforming.

The hand-knotted wool silk carpet supports the firm's premium craftsmanship positioning and project business, so management would likely give it more time rather than withdraw it after only one season.

This low-pile decorative carpet is adjacent to the firm's established offer and helps serve different interior concepts, which suits a company that competes through breadth, materials and design expertise.
The corner bench builds directly on the firm's core furniture business and can serve residential, hospitality and public projects, making it a natural product to retain.
A low-pile carpet is a low-risk complement to the firm's interior collections and customization-oriented sales approach, so it would typically be kept unless clear weakness appears.
The swivel shell chair aligns well with the firm's focus on contemporary living and flexible workplace concepts, so keeping it is consistent with the company's direction.
